newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Chidambaram to address RBI board on Monday.
newsitem.headline: India's Chidambaram to address RBI board on Monday.

text.p: Finance Minister P. Chidambaram will address the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) board of directors on Monday in New Delhi, a central bank spokesperson said on Friday.
"It is the traditional post-budget meeting," she said. "Every year, after the budget the finance minister addresses the RBI board on the budget."
Newspapers reported earlier that Chidambaram, who presented India's 1997/98 budget on February 28, would meet the RBI chief in Bombay on Saturday.
